summary.title: TrustVault
summary.description: Secure document sharing platform with RBAC and append-only audit logging.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.mitigation: Implement rate-limiting middleware (e.g., Django Axes) on login endpoints, enforce account lockout policies after failed attempts, and support multi-factor authentication (MFA).

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Stolen or reused session after revocation
threats.mitigation: Enforce short session expiration times, invalidate session tokens upon logout/revocation via a centralized token version column, and set strict secure cookie flags (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict).

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Mass assignment; admin grants themselves access
threats.mitigation: Explicitly declare form or serializer fields (fields = [...]) in Django forms/DRF serializers, preventing users from injecting privilege or role fields into POST/PUT payloads.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.mitigation: Apply granular rate limiting on resource-heavy routes, set explicit request payload size limits at the reverse proxy/Django settings level, and implement IP-based throttling.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.mitigation: Use centralized base view classes or required decorators (@authorize) for all document endpoints, paired with automated unit tests that verify every route explicitly triggers the authorization check.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.mitigation: Standardize unauthorized responses to return a generic 404 Not Found for both non-existent resources and unauthorized files, preventing resource enumeration.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Document text tricks it into widening access
threats.mitigation: Treat all AI output strictly as untrusted recommendations; enforce a mandatory human-in-the-loop confirmation step before any suggested access grant can be applied.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: File contents sent to an outside API
threats.mitigation: Run language model workflows locally or through isolated, internal-only service containers. Restrict inputs to metadata summaries rather than raw sensitive file bodies.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.mitigation: Store uploaded files entirely outside the public web root (MEDIA_ROOT unexposed to static hosting) and stream file content exclusively through authenticated Django views backed by the single authorization gate.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Grants edited directly in the database
threats.mitigation: Apply least-privilege database user permissions (preventing the Django app connection from running DDL or overriding internal system tables directly), and monitor database activity logs.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Row edited or deleted; chain rewritten
threats.mitigation: Configure PostgreSQL database-level rules or triggers prohibiting UPDATE and DELETE commands on the audit_events table, and maintain row-by-row cryptographic hash chains.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.mitigation: Store daily hash anchor verification summaries on an external read-only medium or a separate append-only log store where the primary Django application possesses zero write access.
